verses.translation: By the sky containing great stars
And [by] the promised Day
And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench[1895]
verses.footnotes: [1895]- Or "May they be destroyed" or "cursed." The "companions of the trench" (or ditch) were agents of a tyrannical king who refused to allow his people to believe in Allāh. Their evil deed in obedience to their ruler earned for them the curse of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) .

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
When they were sitting near it.

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
verses.translation: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses. [1896]
verses.footnotes: [1896]- After casting the believers into a trench filled with fire, they sat at its edge, watching them burn to death. This event occurred before the time of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) .

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Active participle — nominative, masculine, plural, indefinite

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.translation: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.translation: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.[1897]

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have tortured[1898] the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
verses.footnotes: [1898]- Or, in this instance, the literal meaning of "burned" is also appropriate.

segments.gloss: to persecute, to test, to try

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.translation: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.
Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
Honorable Owner of the Throne,
Effecter of what He intends.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to intend, to desire, to want, to wish

verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
[Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?
But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
While Allāh encompasses them from behind.[1899]
But this is an honored Qur’ān
[Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
